SEPARATE_MECHANISM.note: PERMUTATION_MAP_AUTHORITY_V1_AMENDMENT_3 (a11752cb3f51262d) corrects the PERMUTATION map. The CI date-cluster universe is a DISTINCT mechanism and needs its own authority.

CI_DATE_CLUSTER_UNIVERSE.out_of_scope_date_labels: FORBIDDEN from the bootstrap multiplicity vector
CI_DATE_CLUSTER_UNIVERSE.implementation: m_date is drawn as multinomial over the 1,242 DEV dates and scattered into a length-1,254 vector with zeros on HOLDOUT labels

DEFECT_CORRECTED.what: the date-cluster resampling universe was all 1,254 calendar dates rather than the 1,242 DEV dates
DEFECT_CORRECTED.HOLDOUT_outcome_contamination: NONE — CI base rows from HOLDOUT = 0 and CI bootstrap source rows from HOLDOUT = 0, both verified

DEFECT_CORRECTED.classification: SAME SCOPE-DEFECT FAMILY as the permutation leak, but NOT a holdout contamination

OUT_OF_SCOPE_MASS.CORRECTION: an earlier report gave 1.033% without distinguishing expected from realized. That figure was an EMPIRICAL mean over 20 sampled draws, high by sampling variation. Theoretical expectation and realized mean are now labelled separately.
OUT_OF_SCOPE_MASS.rule: expected and realized quantities must never be conflated in provenance
